summary: ConnectM filed an 8-K on a September 28, 2026 amendment to an August 31, 2026 securities purchase agreement with Ascent Partners Fund LLC. The amendment deletes the right of first refusal and MFN provisions upon a Listing Event, replaces the form of Note Two and purchase schedule, amends Notes One and Three to require payment of 105% of principal plus accrued interest at listing, removes conversion into Series C Preferred, and revises registration rights so the initial registration statement is due 60 days after listing. No acquisition, divestiture, or tender is involved; this is a financing-document amendment.
